image.alt: A drawing of a pear-shaped chipped stone handaxe seen face-on against a plain neutral background, with no label, scale bar or catalogue card beside it.

profile.alt: The same handaxe seen edge-on in profile, showing that flakes have been struck from both faces so the piece is worked all the way round to a point.

edge.alt: Close-up of the handaxe's cutting margin, showing small nicks and blunted patches along the edge and one corner battered flat.

butt.alt: The thick, unworked, rounded butt end of the handaxe, with no socket, groove or notch for hafting.

scale.alt: The same handaxe held in an open adult palm, filling the hand, showing its true size and the coarse grain of the quartzite.
